title: eval-harness: add per-prompt metrics integration and CI gating for prompt regressions
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We frequently see subtle regressions caused by prompt set changes that don't show up in aggregate evaluation metrics. This PR integrates per-prompt metrics from the eval-harness into the CI pipeline and introduces a configurable gating step that fails the PR when a prompt's key metrics regress beyond a configured threshold.

What this does: 1) Adds a new GH Actions workflow (ci/eval-per-prompt.yml) that runs the eval-harness on the changed prompt sets and uploads per-prompt metrics to the CI job logs and to a temporary S3 artifact. 2) Adds a lightweight per-prompt metrics comparator (tools/eval/compare_per_prompt.py) that consumes previous baseline metrics and the current run and emits a pass/fail verdict and a human-readable summary. 3) Hooks the comparator into the workflow so a failing per-prompt regression will mark the job failed. 4) Adds documentation and onboarding notes for maintainers (docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md).

Design notes: - Thresholds are configurable via .github/eval-config.yaml and default to 3% absolute drop on key metrics (accuracy/rouge/beam-f1 depending on prompt family). - The comparator emits a concise table of the top 10 regressions and stores the full JSON artifact for debugging. - To avoid noisy failures on very small sample prompts we apply a minimum-sample filter and flag prompts for manual review instead of auto-fail when samples < 30.

Testing done: - Local runs against the nightly baseline produced expected pass/fail flags. - End-to-end GH Action run on this branch executed against a synthetic prompt delta; workflow artifacts attached. - Added unit tests for comparator logic and config parsing.

Rollout plan: Start as optional check for eval-maintainers team, monitor false positive rate for two weeks, then flip to required for prod model changes.

Related: ENG-4212 (per-prompt observability), PM-110 (owner: prompt quality initiative).

squash: eval-harness per-prompt CI metrics integration

Adds per-prompt comparator and CI workflow to detect prompt regressions
release_notes: Add per-prompt evaluation metrics to CI with configurable gating thresholds. This helps catch prompt-specific regressions earlier in code review and reduces noisy rollouts.
notes_for_maintainers: After merge: 1) Add eval-baseline artifacts storage retention to S3 bucket for 30 days. 2) Beta enablement: add 'required' protection rule for branch 'main' for the ci-eval-per-prompt workflow once false-positive rate < 5%.
